structuredContent.measurement: Serialized exposed MCP schemas; not provider tokens or invocation latency.

wireDefinitions.name: capabilities_inventory
wireDefinitions.description:
Inventory actually exposed MCP tools without executing them. Returns names,
read-only hints and schema byte counts, not full schemas or provider tokens.
Compact advertises discovery/core schemas; all enabled leaves remain discoverable.

wireDefinitions.name: capabilities_list
wireDefinitions.description:
List enabled operations without full schemas. Compact covers all MCP domains
as mcp.tool.<legacy_name>. Pin revision when paging. Discovery grants no access.

wireDefinitions.name: capabilities_search
wireDefinitions.description:
Search enabled tools by name/keywords, returning bounded exact input schemas.
Compact covers every MCP domain, not only Todo/Memory. Cache unchanged contracts.

wireDefinitions.name: capabilities_describe
wireDefinitions.description:
Read one exact contract. mcp.tool.<legacy_name> covers enabled MCP tools;
canonical todo.* / memory.* contracts remain compatible. Never executes.

wireDefinitions.name: capability_read
wireDefinitions.description:
Read a discovered operation using its exact arguments and original executor.
mcp.tool.* preserves original MCP results; canonical pilot IDs return envelopes.
Mutation operations are rejected; original middleware/authorization still apply.

wireDefinitions.name: capability_call
wireDefinitions.description:
Mutate a discovered operation through its original executor, validation,
CAS, authority and audit. No role override or local-user Memory decision.
mcp.tool.* preserves original results. Never blindly retry committed effects.

wireDefinitions.name: check_version
wireDefinitions.description: Return the unified server version and its component schema versions.

wireDefinitions.name: mcp_lifecycle_status
wireDefinitions.description: Report actual runtime ownership, admission and in-flight drain state. Never replays a write.

wireDefinitions.name: mcp_lifecycle_quiesce
wireDefinitions.description: Fence only this managed process before its owning client drains/closes it. Never cancels or replays tools.

Progress posts (continue_working=true) return immediately. A final post
atomically enters blocking standby and returns only for the next directed
message, stop/close, transport error, or client cancellation. Heartbeat
timeouts are consumed internally, so the Agent cannot forget to wait.
Posts require a reply by default. Pass require_reply=false for a pure
acknowledgement, FYI, or progress update that must not continue the exchange.

structuredContent.description:
Read-only Note inventory. limit defaults to 50; limit=0 returns all matches.

directory accepts a Notes-relative folder or copied pkm://notes/<folder>/ path;
recursive includes subfolders. Returns stable knowledge_id/source_id
when present, identity completeness, total, next_offset and inventory_revision.
Follow next_offset until null and pass the first revision on every later page;
concurrent changes fail explicitly. Legacy notes without IDs are marked missing,
never assigned fake stable IDs. Hidden/asset/Trash folders are excluded.
Positive limit sets the maximum number returned, with no fixed upper cap.
Every call returns the same inventory envelope. type: general/todo/done/observation/data-path.

{"revision":"8f4de8526bc2b4a043cfb493c180709292ed245bbf97bef8b7e9e4b4891a76a5","id":"mcp.tool.note_work_item_command","version":1,"transportName":"note_work_item_command","description":"Apply one digest-CAS Work Item lifecycle command under the shared mutation lock.

Commands: create/edit with item; claim/release/accept/reopen with id and
optional reason; transition with id,state,optional reason,blockedReason,outcome,evidence.
Default external identity is mcp:external. For a distinct external Agent,
the user assigns external:copilot/claude/other:<id> in Board UI and copies
a Board-scoped worker token to that Agent. Supply worker_token to use that
identity, never a caller role override. Tokens grant worker policy only.
This command API is the only supported Agent write path. Raw file edits
and generic Markdown updates are not Todo editing interfaces.
Rotating the token invalidates previous access. Native Chats have stable
identities without a token.
This compatibility endpoint retains restrictive worker policy; use the
named Board APIs for contract/Story management and soft-delete/restore.
Workers create unowned Planning items, claim them, edit only their own
nonterminal evidence/links/verification/blockedReason, and transition them.
Done requires outcome and evidence, not acceptance. Accept requires a user
or an explicitly user-delegated reviewer and reason; reopen is user-only
with reason. Release requires owner and reason. History is generated.
OnHold requires reason and retains ownership. On dedicated Boards, claims,
Active resumes and active reassignment enforce one WIP task per stable Agent
across all Boards in the knowledge root. WORKITEM_FOCUS_CONFLICT changes nothing:
explicitly put current work OnHold, submit real completion evidence, or defer
the new task. Never silently suspend/complete previous work.
Never blindly retry conflicts or lower acceptance criteria.","inputSchema":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"slug":{"type":"string"},"expected_digest":{"type":"string"},"command":{"additionalProperties":true,"type":"object"},"worker_token":{"anyOf":[{"type":"string"},{"type":"null"}],"default":null}},"required":["slug","expected_digest","command"],"type":"object"},"outputSchema":{"additionalProperties":true,"type":"object"},"readOnly":false,"authorization":"Original MCP tool, middleware and target-specific checks. {"revision":"8f4de8526bc2b4a043cfb493c180709292ed245bbf97bef8b7e9e4b4891a76a5","id":"mcp.tool.portal_control","version":1,"transportName":"portal_control","description":"Use a temporary Portal or an explicitly configured saved endpoint.

connections lists local saved endpoints and live temporary connections.
A saved endpoint id can be used as context_id after separate local external-access
approval. Configure and pair named endpoints in Portal Connections on both Hosts.
Named endpoints reconnect across restarts without replaying tasks; each side
independently enables incoming control and grants revocable local permissions.
Replacing or deleting a bound Chat clears its grants and stops old execution.
The following open workflow creates a temporary Portal, not a saved endpoint.

First open without context_id: native VS Code UI asks only Controller or Controlled.
Controller automatically resolves the endpoint and copies a private code; Controlled
pastes it locally and approves control. No name, create/accept or address configuration.
Private codes never enter tool arguments. No PKM Chat is created.
Poll api_chat_request_get for the local receipt and keep contextId in this conversation.
status/send/command/get/attempts/cancel/disconnect/switch/permissions/files require that handle.
command executes a structured {program, arguments, cwd?, timeoutSeconds?} directly
on the executing Host without any LLM. Only that Host grants code execution.
route selects exactly one already-connected, authorized-direction Host matching
requirements {platform?: win32|linux|darwin, programs?: [cmd|powershell|bash|...]}.
route may omit context_id; ambiguity or missing capabilities fails without execution.
Routing never copies credentials, pairs silently or automatically replays commands.
get/cancel use the returned contextId and original request_id for either mode.
get always reads the original attempt, not the latest Chat message. attempts
requests explicit executing-user consent to share linked manual rerun results,
separately from the immutable original receipt; never replays the task.
Both Hosts must advertise commands-v1; older Hosts require upgrading and pairing again.
Brief transport loss keeps the pairing for 2 minutes (status=reconnecting) while it reconnects;
disconnect, Host restart or a longer outage ends it: open and pair again,
never reattach or replay tasks. Pairing credentials, connection history and remote-task
receipts are not persisted; same-connection duplicates are suppressed in memory.
Task history belongs to controller/controlled Chats; Copilot records only tool
information it actually receives. Local controlled execution requires selecting an
existing PKM Chat for each task, never auto-creation. send needs a stable UUID
request_id; get polls the ORIGINAL remote task while connected. permissions opens
local timed authorization. files offers one batch of local file_paths, or a picker
when omitted; every batch ALWAYS needs controlled-user consent, even under Allow All.
Both Hosts must support transfers. External access requires local consent or an
unexpired connection grant; MCP cannot authenticate individual Copilot conversations.
open completes after pairing, link expiry or void (at most 10 minutes); its receipt
state is connected/awaiting-peer/disconnected. endpointScope=forwarded-localhost means
loopback on the VS Code UI computer, not proof the peer is unreachable. After pairing,
the local user is offered one fixed-deadline external grant bound to this pairing/
direction. No automatic replay, role escalation, SSH or NAT traversal.","inputSchema":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"host_id":{"type":"string"},"operation":{"type":"string"},"command_id":{"type":"string"},"context_id":{"default":"","type":"string"},"prompt":{"default":"","type":"string"},"request_id":{"default":"","type":"string"},"file_paths":{"anyOf":[{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"},{"type":"null"}],"default":null},"command":{"anyOf":[{"additionalProperties":true,"type":"object"},{"type":"null"}],"default":null},"requirements":{"anyOf":[{"additionalProperties":true,"type":"object"},{"type":"null"}],"default":null}},"required":["host_id","operation","command_id"],"type":"object"},"outputSchema":{"additionalProperties":true,"type":"object"},"readOnly":false,"authorization":"Original MCP tool, middleware and target-specific checks. Discovery grants no access.","result":"Original MCP content and structured result, not a pilot envelope.","lifecycle":{"legacyAlias":"portal_control"}}

connections lists local saved endpoints and live temporary connections.

Replacing or deleting a bound Chat clears its grants and stops old execution.
The following open workflow creates a temporary Portal, not a saved endpoint.

First open without context_id: native VS Code UI asks only Controller or Controlled.
Controller automatically resolves the endpoint and copies a private code; Controlled
pastes it locally and approves control. No name, create/accept or address configuration.
Private codes never enter tool arguments. No PKM Chat is created.
Poll api_chat_request_get for the local receipt and keep contextId in this conversation.
status/send/command/get/attempts/cancel/disconnect/switch/permissions/files require that handle.
command executes a structured {program, arguments, cwd?, timeoutSeconds?} directly
on the executing Host without any LLM. Only that Host grants code execution.
route selects exactly one already-connected, authorized-direction Host matching
requirements {platform?: win32|linux|darwin, programs?: [cmd|powershell|bash|...]}.
route may omit context_id; ambiguity or missing capabilities fails without execution.
Routing never copies credentials, pairs silently or automatically replays commands.
get/cancel use the returned contextId and original request_id for either mode.
get always reads the original attempt, not the latest Chat message. attempts
requests explicit executing-user consent to share linked manual rerun results,
separately from the immutable original receipt; never replays the task.
Both Hosts must advertise commands-v1; older Hosts require upgrading and pairing again.
Brief transport loss keeps the pairing for 2 minutes (status=reconnecting) while it reconnects;
disconnect, Host restart or a longer outage ends it: open and pair again,

receipts are not persisted; same-connection duplicates are suppressed in memory.

existing PKM Chat for each task, never auto-creation. send needs a stable UUID

Search one typed index containing local Skills/Notes/Research/Scripts/Recipes and subscribed content.

Routes lexical / semantic / dual are explicit. No embedding configuration means
semantic_status=off without loading an encoder. Dual uses RRF and preserves path evidence.

content_type_filter is strict; type words in query text are only soft preferences. Graph
traversal is bounded and filtered before unavailable targets can enter the result.

a Board-scoped worker token to that Agent. Supply worker_token to use that
identity, never a caller role override. Tokens grant worker policy only.
This command API is the only supported Agent write path. Raw file edits
and generic Markdown updates are not Todo editing interfaces.
Rotating the token invalidates previous access. Native Chats have stable
identities without a token.

named Board APIs for contract/Story management and soft-delete/restore.

across all Boards in the knowledge root. WORKITEM_FOCUS_CONFLICT changes nothing:
explicitly put current work OnHold, submit real completion evidence, or defer
the new task. Never silently suspend/complete previous work.

operations.description:
Read-only Note inventory. limit defaults to 50; limit=0 returns all matches.

directory accepts a Notes-relative folder or copied pkm://notes/<folder>/ path;
recursive includes subfolders. Returns stable knowledge_id/source_id
when present, identity completeness, total, next_offset and inventory_revision.
Follow next_offset until null and pass the first revision on every later page;
concurrent changes fail explicitly. Legacy notes without IDs are marked missing,
never assigned fake stable IDs. Hidden/asset/Trash folders are excluded.
Positive limit sets the maximum number returned, with no fixed upper cap.
Every call returns the same inventory envelope. type: general/todo/done/observation/data-path.

operations.description:
Apply one digest-CAS Work Item lifecycle command under the shared mutation lock.

Commands: create/edit with item; claim/release/accept/reopen with id and
optional reason; transition with id,state,optional reason,blockedReason,outcome,evidence.
Default external identity is mcp:external. For a distinct external Agent,
the user assigns external:copilot/claude/other:<id> in Board UI and copies
a Board-scoped worker token to that Agent. Supply worker_token to use that
identity, never a caller role override. Tokens grant worker policy only.
This command API is the only supported Agent write path. Raw file edits
and generic Markdown updates are not Todo editing interfaces.
Rotating the token invalidates previous access. Native Chats have stable
identities without a token.
This compatibility endpoint retains restrictive worker policy; use the
named Board APIs for contract/Story management and soft-delete/restore.
Workers create unowned Planning items, claim them, edit only their own
nonterminal evidence/links/verification/blockedReason, and transition them.
Done requires outcome and evidence, not acceptance. Accept requires a user
or an explicitly user-delegated reviewer and reason; reopen is user-only
with reason. Release requires owner and reason. History is generated.
OnHold requires reason and retains ownership. On dedicated Boards, claims,
Active resumes and active reassignment enforce one WIP task per stable Agent
across all Boards in the knowledge root. WORKITEM_FOCUS_CONFLICT changes nothing:
explicitly put current work OnHold, submit real completion evidence, or defer
the new task. Never silently suspend/complete previous work.
Never blindly retry conflicts or lower acceptance criteria.

get always reads the original attempt, not the latest Chat message. attempts
requests explicit executing-user consent to share linked manual rerun results,
separately from the immutable original receipt; never replays the task.

Brief transport loss keeps the pairing for 2 minutes (status=reconnecting) while it reconnects;
disconnect, Host restart or a longer outage ends it: open and pair again,
never reattach or replay tasks. Pairing credentials, connection history and remote-task

unexpired connection grant; MCP cannot authenticate individual Copilot conversations.
open completes after pairing, link expiry or void (at most 10 minutes); its receipt
